name: Waterman's Camp
description_short: A small-group ocean skills program for ages 13–15 at Rexhame Beach in Marshfield. Campers learn to surf, paddleboard and handle tricky conditions, 4 hours a day, Monday through Thursday.
refund_policy_summary: 10% deposit is non-refundable. Cancel 60+ days before start for a 90% refund; 30–59 days before for 50%; no refund within 30 days or during the session, and none for missed days, late arrivals or early pickups. Full refund if camp is canceled for public health reasons. You can switch sessions for free if space allows.
swim_waterfront_notes: Held on the ocean at Rexhame Beach. Campers surf and paddleboard, and session times change with the tide. Swim ability requirements and lifeguard staffing are not stated.
